 Bring your expertise to a high\-visibility internal consulting team where you can shape target\-state processes, strengthen controls, and grow your impact across the business.
   

  

 As a Process Improvement Associate in the Performance Consulting – Process Intelligence team within Consumer and Community Banking, you will partner with business leaders and subject matter experts to analyze end\-to\-end processes and design ideal target\-state workflows. You will apply process improvement skills, critical thinking, and data\-driven diagnostics to identify root causes and generate practical solutions that improve efficiency and reduce risk. You will help advance intelligent automation and robotic process automation opportunities, including the integration of artificial intelligence and machine learning capabilities, while communicating recommendations in an executive\-ready way.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities**
* Develop detailed process maps, workflows, and documentation to synthesize findings, shape recommendations, and influence senior stakeholders through clear storytelling
* Leverage firm\-approved artificial intelligence tools and developer copilots to enhance delivery approaches and continuously improve the team's process intelligence offerings
* Partner with project team members to interview stakeholders, analyze process documentation, and gather data to identify improvement opportunities
* Lead one or more projects by demonstrating leadership through influence and strengthening team and organizational culture
* Collaborate with the team to build hypothesis sets, analyses, and roadmaps while identifying roadblocks, escalating risks, and proposing solutions
* Analyze key business processes to identify opportunities for improvement and automation, using data analytics to provide ongoing insight
* Contribute to the testing and deployment of process tools and technologies to ensure alignment with operational standards and objectives
* Facilitate working sessions to align stakeholders on current\-state pain points, target\-state design decisions, and ownership for follow\-through
* Quantify operational, risk, and financial impact opportunities to support prioritization and clarify expected benefits
* Embed risk and control considerations into target\-state process designs to support well\-controlled execution and change readiness
* Support change adoption by preparing clear materials and reinforcing new ways of working with partner teams


**Required Qualifications, Skills, And Capabilities**
* Use process mapping tools (for example, Microsoft Visio, Signavio, or Business Process Model and Notation) to document and analyze workflows
* Apply data analytics to interpret models and diagrams and communicate data requirements and assets clearly
* Communicate complex ideas, concepts, or data through effective storytelling for diverse audiences
* Collaborate with diverse teams with varied experiences, skills, and backgrounds
* Operate artificial intelligence tools responsibly, including exposure to data and knowledge work, learning from experience, reasoning and planning, and safe human–artificial intelligence interaction
* Demonstrate strong problem\-solving, client management, and executive\-level communication skills
* Own tasks and manage most elements of an end\-to\-end workstream with appropriate follow\-up and accountability
* Translate ambiguous problems into structured hypotheses, clear workplans, and actionable outputs
* Produce concise, executive\-ready materials that connect findings to recommendations and decisions
* Practice sound risk awareness when proposing process changes that affect controls, roles, or handoffs
* Adapt quickly across multiple initiatives while maintaining quality and attention to detail


**Preferred Qualifications, Skills, And Capabilities**
* Create senior\-ready presentations and narratives in written and verbal formats
* Apply systems thinking to analyze complex processes and identify optimization and integration opportunities
* Align process improvements to customer service principles to enhance satisfaction and outcomes
* Foster cross\-functional collaboration to identify and implement improvement opportunities across teams
* Use agile methodologies to iteratively develop and refine process improvements with flexibility and responsiveness to change
* Bring: "Preferred experience supporting more than one CCB Operations Function/Line of Business"
* Demonstrate: “Developing experience using AI\-powered analytics, workflow automation, or intelligent process tools to drive efficiency gains, reduce manual effort, or improve accuracy in operational processes.”


**About Us**
 JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.
   

  

 We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.
   

  

**About The Team**
 Our Consumer \& Community Banking division serves our Chase customers through a range of financial services, including personal banking, credit cards, mortgages, auto financing, investment advice, small business loans and payment processing. We're proud to lead the U.S. in credit card sales and deposit growth and have the most\-used digital solutions – all while ranking first in customer satisfaction.
   

  

 Operations teams develop and manage innovative, secure service solutions to meet clients' needs globally. Developing and using the latest technology, teams work to deliver industry\-leading capabilities to our clients and customers, making it easy and convenient to do business with the firm. Teams also drive growth by refining technology\-driven customer and client experiences that put users first, providing an unparalleled experience.

title: Senior Analyst, Drug Information & Risk Management
description:
**About Apotex Inc.**
 Apotex is a Canadian\-based global health company. We improve everyday access to affordable, innovative medicines and health products for millions of people worldwide, with a broad portfolio of generic, biosimilar, innovative branded pharmaceuticals and consumer health products. Headquartered in Toronto, with regional offices globally, including in the United States, Mexico and India, we are the largest Canadian\-based pharmaceutical company and a health partner of choice for the Americas for pharmaceutical licensing and product acquisitions.
   

  

 For more information visit: www.apotex.com .
   

  

**Job Summary**
 Part of multi\-disciplined team of healthcare professionals who support Apotex products (domestic and international) by coordination of the development of medical documents such as Risk Management \& Risk Evaluation Mitigation Plans, informing internal and external customers of the safe and effective use of drugs manufactured and marketed by Apotex Inc. and their affiliates/distributors worldwide by providing professional, unbiased, clinically relevant and timely medical information.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities**
* Provides verbal and written responses to medical inquiries from healthcare professionals, sales representatives and other internal customers on Apotex products.
* Evaluates, analyzes and responds to medical inquiries in an accurate, balanced and timely manner.
* Coordinates the preparation/updating of Risk Management \& Risk Evaluation Mitigation Plans globally including input into the medical sections of them using relevant regional templates.
* Demonstrates technical and scientific skills in the research and interpretation of medical information.
* Creates and peer reviews new and revised medical information documents (e.g. response documents, recall QAs, bulletins, etc.)
* Participates in departmental and cross\-functional business teams by supporting team initiatives and contributing directly or indirectly to team goals/projects based on priority to the business. Ensures compliance with all SOPs pertaining to adverse event and quality complaint reporting.
* Maintains awareness of current therapeutics and industry\-based medical information regulations.
* Provides on\-call coverage as per schedule
* Assists in the preparation of reports
* Updates/maintains product databases/files as required.
* Works as a member of a team to achieve all outcomes. Performs all work in accordance with all established regulatory and compliance and safety requirements.
* Perform all other duties and special projects and after\-hour coverage of DISPedia unit as assigned.
* Works in a safe manner collaborating as a team member to achieve all outcomes.
* Demonstrate Behaviours that exhibit our organizational Values: Collaboration, Courage, Perseverance, and Passion.
* Ensure personal adherence with all compliance programs including the Global Business Ethics and Compliance Program, Global Quality policies and procedures, Safety and Environment policies, and HR policies.
* All other relevant duties as assigned.


**Job Requirements** 
  

  

* Education
+ Bachelor of Pharmacy.
+ Sc., or Diploma in Health/Science related discipline
+ Master of Pharmacy
+ Bachelor of Dental Surgery

* Knowledge, Skills and Abilities
+ Excellent oral/written communication skills.
+ Knowledge of Microsoft office software: Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Outlook, etc.
+ Knowledge of Arisg Safety Database, MedDRA and Argus
+ Knowledge of Embase and MLM database
+ Knowledge of online literature searching and review.


  

  

* Experience
+ 1\-3 years of experience in Pharmacovigilance.


 At Apotex, we are committed to fostering a welcoming andaccessible work environment, where all everyone feels valued, respected, and supported to succeed.
   

  

 We offer accommodation for applicants with disabilities as part of its recruitment process. If you are contacted to arrange for an interview or testing, please advise us if you require an accommodation.
   

  

**For any inquiries regarding this posting, please contact: rpalkar@apotex.co.in**

title: RC FS-BT INS- P and C NON USA-Senior
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Business Consultant \-Senior**
 At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**About Global Delivery Services**
 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
   

  

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
   

  

 Enablement Services provides cost\-effective, high\-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Worked on multiple Business transformation, upgrade and modernization programs.
* Requirements Gathering, Elicitation –writing BRDs, FSDs. Conducting JAD sessions and Workshops to capture requirements and working close with Product Owner.
* Work with the client to define the most optimal future state operational process and related product configuration.
* Define scope by providing innovative solutions and challenging all new client requirements and change requests but simultaneously ensuring that client gets the required business value.
* Elaborate and deliver clearly defined requirement documents with relevant dataflow and process flow diagrams.
* Work closely with product design development team to analyse and extract functional enhancements.
* Provide product consultancy and assist the client with acceptance criteria gathering and support throughout the project life cycle.
* Responsible for decision\-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
* Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Product Knowledge – Guidewire, Duckcreek, Exigent, Majesco. (Preferred Guidewire/Duckcreek)
* Strong skills in stakeholder management and communication.
* Should have end to end processes in P\&C insurance domain.
* Data transformation, Business data modelling, Data mapping, transformation rules, data migration, data profiling, data visualisation, Tableau, Power\-BI, Reporting, Basic understanding of SQL query
* AI and Gen AI use cases implementation, Understanding of AI architecture for AI Use cases
* Should be ready to work in flexible shifts (a good amount of overlap with US/UK hours).
* Good organizational and time management skills required.
* Should have good written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Industry certifications AINS 21 \- Property and Liability Insurance Principles, AINS 22 \- Personal Insurance, AINS 23 \- Commercial Insurance and AINS 24 \- General Insurance for IT and Support Professionals will be added advantage.
* Additional experience in Life or other insurance domain is added advantage.
* We expect you to work effectively as a team member and build good relationships with the client. You will have the opportunity to expand your domain knowledge and skills and will be able to collaborate frequently with other EY professionals with a wide variety of expertise.


**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
   

  

 Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
   

  

 To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability\-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
   

  

* Our Commitment: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
* Professional Development: From entry\-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
* People and Culture: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
* Benefits: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting\-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
* How to Apply: If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user\-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.


 Successful candidates advance to a competency\-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
   

  

 “We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion”.
   

  

**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Business Operations & Growth Intern
description:
Stipend: ₹10,000–₹15,000/month \| Full\-time Internship \| On\-site \| Thane, Maharashtra
 



  

  





 About Mad Over Blog:
 



 Mad Over Blog is an SEO and organic growth company helping businesses grow through search, content, websites and digital channels.
 



 We work with businesses on SEO, content, e\-commerce, website projects and digital growth initiatives.
 



  

  





 About the role:
 



 We are looking for a proactive and organized
 **Business Operations \& Growth Intern** 
 to work closely with management and internal specialists.
 



 This is a generalist execution role. You do not need to be an expert in SEO, development, design or AI. Your primary responsibility will be to
 **coordinate, execute, follow up and ensure that assigned work moves forward on time.** 




  





  





**What will you do:** 




  





**Business Operations \& Coordination** 



* Maintain project and task trackers.
* Coordinate with internal team members and follow up on assigned tasks.
* Track deadlines, dependencies and pending items.
* Prepare daily and weekly progress updates.
* Escalate delayed or blocked tasks to management.



  





**Client Coordination** 



* Coordinate with assigned clients such as RoopSangam Gems \& Jewellery.
* Collect requirements, information and approvals.
* Convert client requirements into clear internal tasks.
* Coordinate with SEO, content and development specialists.



  





**SEO \& Organic Growth Support** 



* Assist with keyword and competitor research.
* Support content and SEO execution.
* Track ongoing organic\-growth activities.
* Prepare basic progress reports.



  





**E\-commerce \& Marketplace Support** 



* Assist with product catalogue and marketplace activities.
* Coordinate product titles, descriptions, images and other listing information.
* Support marketplace research across platforms such as Amazon, Flipkart and other relevant channels.



  





**AI \& Content Support** 



* Use AI tools to create first drafts of website, product and marketing content.
* Assist with FAQs, product descriptions and basic content research.
* Use AI\-assisted creative tools for simple visual concepts.
* Review AI\-generated output for accuracy, readability and brand consistency.



  





**Hiring \& Team Support** 



* Assist with candidate sourcing and interview coordination.
* Maintain recruitment trackers.
* Support onboarding and basic team coordination.



  





 What are we looking for:
 


* Strong communication and follow\-up skills.
* Good written English.
* Good organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Comfortable using Google Sheets/Excel and Google Docs.
* Comfortable using AI tools and willing to learn new tools.
* Interest in SEO, websites, e\-commerce and digital business.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines.
* Proactive attitude and willingness to take ownership.



  





**Freshers and candidates with limited prior experience are welcome.** 




  

  





 What will you learn:
 



  





 Will gain hands\-on exposure to:
 


* Business operations
* Project coordination
* Client communication
* SEO and organic growth
* E\-commerce and marketplaces
* Recruitment coordination
* AI\-assisted content and creative workflows
* Digital business development



  





 Performance will be evaluated based on:
 


* Timely completion of assigned tasks
* Quality of follow\-ups
* Accuracy of reports and trackers
* Communication with clients and team members
* Ability to identify and resolve routine issues
* Ability to take increasing ownership over time



 Growth:
 



 Based on performance and business requirements, successful interns may be considered for a full\-time opportunity with increased responsibility in business operations, client success, project management or digital growth.
 



  





**Compensation \& Benefits** 



* Monthly stipend:
 **₹10,000–₹15,000** 
 , depending on experience, skills and interview performance.
* Full\-time, on\-site internship in Thane.
* Hands\-on exposure to SEO, business operations, client coordination, e\-commerce, AI tools and digital growth.
* Opportunity to be considered for a full\-time role based on performance and business requirements.



  





**Hiring Process** 




 Our hiring process generally includes:
 


1. Application and resume review
2. Shortlisted candidates are contacted for an initial discussion
3. Interview with the management team
4. Final selection and offer



  





**Applicant Privacy** 




 Information submitted during the application process, including your resume and contact details, will be used only for recruitment and hiring\-related purposes. Applicant information will be handled confidentially and will not be sold or used for unrelated marketing purposes.

title: Product Stewardship Specialist
description:
At Dow, we believe in putting people first and we’re passionate about delivering integrity, respect and safety to our customers, our employees and the planet.
   

  

 Our people are at the heart of our solutions. They reflect the communities we live in and the world where we do business. Their diversity is our strength. We’re a community of relentless problem solvers that offers the daily opportunity to contribute with your perspective, transform industries and shape the future. Our purpose is simple \- to deliver a sustainable future for the world through science and collaboration. If you’re looking for a challenge and meaningful role, you’re in the right place.
   

  

**About You On This Role**
 We are committed to delivering fast, accurate, and customer\-centric support that helps customers confidently navigate product safety, compliance, and regulatory requirements.
   

  

 As a
 **Product Stewardship Specialist** 
 , you will play a critical role in ensuring the safe and compliant use of our products by addressing Environmental, Health \& Safety (EH\&S) and regulatory inquiries from customers and internal stakeholders. This position sits at the intersection of customer care, product stewardship, and regulatory compliance, requiring strong collaboration, analytical thinking, and effective communication. The ideal candidate is highly organized, customer\-focused, and experienced in regulatory and compliance\-related topics. You will thrive in a dynamic, multinational environment by effectively managing priorities, analyzing data, tracking progress, and partnering with global teams to deliver timely and accurate solutions.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Serve as the primary point of contact for customer Environmental, Health \& Safety (EH\&S) and regulatory inquiries, providing timely and accurate responses while engaging subject matter experts when required.
* Manage and track customer inquiries through internal systems, ensuring proper documentation, timely follow\-up, and resolution of high\-priority requests.
* Execute established escalation processes for complex regulatory, toxicology, RDS statement, and product communication requests to ensure customer needs are addressed effectively.
* Analyze inquiry trends and collaborate with Enterprise Product Stewardship Services (PSS) teams to enhance self\-service resources, streamline processes, and improve customer experience.
* Prioritize workload based on business requirements, customer expectations, and real\-time performance metrics to maintain service excellence.
* Support EH\&S data harmonization initiatives, maintain compliance\-related documentation, and deliver training and guidance to customer\-facing teams on EH\&S information management and regulatory requirements.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in chemistry, Environmental Science, Toxicology, Industrial Hygiene, Product Stewardship, Product Regulatory Affairs, Sustainability, or related EH\&S discipline.
* Minimum of 3 years of relevant industry experience in Product Stewardship, Regulatory Affairs, EH\&S, or a related function.
* Strong knowledge of global regulatory frameworks, products, and markets, preferably within Silicone products and applications for Home \& Personal Care industries.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including Outlook, Word, and Excel; SAP experience is considered an advantage.
* Excellent verbal and written English communication skills.


**Your Skills**
* Strong customer\-focused mindset with a passion for delivering accurate, timely, and high\-quality support.
* Curiosity and willingness to continuously expand knowledge in chemistry, silicone products, and global regulatory requirements.
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, enabling effective collaboration across technical, commercial, and global teams.
* Strong organizational and time\-management skills, with the ability to work independently and make sound business decisions. Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret complex data and draw meaningful conclusions.
* Effective stakeholder management and collaboration skills across multiple functions and geographies.
* Solution\-oriented approach with a focus on continuous improvement and efficient problem\-solving. Ability to manage competing priorities, meet deadlines, and perform effectively in a fast\-paced, multicultural environment.


**Additional Notes**
* Relocation/visa sponsorship is not aligned with this role
* This role offers the opportunity to collaborate with global product stewardship professionals, technical experts, and business teams while supporting customers across multiple regions.
* Success in this position requires a strong commitment to regulatory compliance, customer satisfaction, attention to detail, and continuous process improvement.
* This role provides exposure to international regulatory frameworks and the opportunity to contribute to the safe and sustainable use of Dow products worldwide.


**Benefits – What Dow Offers You**
 We invest in you.
   

  

 Dow invests in total rewards programs to help you manage all aspects of you: your pay, your health, your life, your future, and your career. You bring your background, talent, and perspective to work every day. Dow rewards that commitment by investing in your total wellbeing.
   

  

 Here are just a few highlights of what you would be offered as a Dow employee:
   

  

* Equitable and market\-competitive base pay and bonus opportunity across our global markets, along with locally relevant incentives.
* Benefits and programs to support your physical, mental, financial, and social well\-being, to help you get the care you need...when you need it.
* Competitive retirement program that may include company\-provided benefits, savings opportunities, financial planning, and educational resources to help you achieve your long term financial\-goals.
+ Employee stock purchase programs (availability varies depending on location).

* Student Debt Retirement Savings Match Program (U.S. only).
+ Dow will take the value of monthly student debt payments and apply them as if they are contributions to the Employees’ Savings Plan (401(k)), helping employees reach the Company match.

* Robust medical and life insurance packages that offer a variety of coverage options to meet your individual needs. Travel insurance is also available in certain countries/locations.
* Opportunities to learn and grow through training and mentoring, work experiences, community involvement and team building.
* Workplace culture empowering role\-based flexibility to maximize personal productivity and balance personal needs.
* Competitive yearly vacation allowance.
* Paid time off for new parents (birthing and non\-birthing, including adoptive and foster parents).
* Paid time off to care for family members who are sick or injured.
* Paid time off to support volunteering and Employee Resource Group’s (ERG) participation.
* Wellbeing Portal for all Dow employees, our one\-stop shop to promote wellbeing, empowering employees to take ownership of their entire wellbeing journey.
* On\-site fitness facilities to help stay healthy and active (availability varies depending on location).
* Employee discounts for online shopping, cinema tickets, gym memberships and more.
* Additionally, some of our locations might offer:
+ Transportation allowance (availability varies depending on location)
+ Meal subsidiaries/vouchers (availability varies depending on location)
+ Carbon\-neutral transportation incentives e.g. bike to work (availability varies depending on location)


 Join our team, we can make a difference together.
   

  

**About Dow Chemical International Pvt Ltd**
 Dow Chemical International Private Limited (Dow India) aims to be the most innovative, sustainable, inclusive customer\-centric materials science company. The company is committed to delivering the right solutions to its customers’ challenges. With broadest technology sets spanning performance materials, industrial intermediates, and plastics Dow India delivers differentiated science\-based products and solutions in high\-growth segments, such as packaging, infrastructure, automobile, and consumer care.
   

  

 A Great Place to Work® Certified company with approximately over 1000 employees, its operations comprise of manufacturing sites, innovation center, established centers of excellence, and commercial office. As a responsible corporate, the company supports its Corporate Social Responsibility (program) with technology expertise and employee volunteerism. Dow India works with non\-profit partners towards the empowerment of differently abled, women, and children in communities where it operates. The company aims to redefine the societal blueprint, by supporting holistic sustainability and circular economy initiatives.
   

  

 As part of our dedication to inclusion, Dow is committed to equal opportunities in employment. We encourage every employee to bring their whole self to work each day to not only deliver more value, but also have a more fulfilling career. Further information regarding Dow's equal opportunities is available on www.dow.com.

title: Product Support Engineer
description:
**Company Description**
**NEC Software Solutions (India)**
 On 1st July 2021, Rave Technologies became NEC Software Solutions India. This change brought us under the global NEC Corporation brand. We are proud to be part of an organisation with 122 years of experience in evolution with technology and innovation.
   

  

 We have more than 30 years of experience in providing end to end IT services across the globe and have earned a reputation for delighting our customers by consistently surpassing expectations and helping them deliver robust, market\-ready software products that meet the highest standards of engineering and user experience. Supported by more than 1300 exceptionally talented manpower, we are a hub for offshore support and technology services.
   

  

 We work with diverse industry verticals which include publishing, media, financial services, retail, healthcare and technology companies around the world. Our customers range from two\-person startups to $bn listed companies.
   

  

 For more information, visit at www.necsws.com/india.
   

  

**About NEC Corporation**
 NEC Corporation is a Japanese multinational information technology and electronics company, headquartered in Tokyo, Japan. It is recognised as a ‘Top 50 Innovative Company’ globally and the NEC Group globally provides “Solutions for Society” that promote the safety, security, fairness and equality of society. Their main goal is to help create a safer society with their innovations in technologies.
   

  

 NEC Corporation has established itself as a leader in the integration of IT and network technologies while promoting the brand statement of “Orchestrating a brighter world.” NEC enables businesses and communities to adapt to rapid changes taking place in both society and the market as it provides for the social values of safety, security, fairness and efficiency to promote a more sustainable world where everyone has the chance to reach their full potential.
   

  

 For more information, visit NEC at https://www.nec.com.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Key Duties \& Responsibilities:**
* Investigating, triaging, and resolving incidents, taking ownership through to closure.
* Providing technical support directly to customers.
* Liaising with NEC development teams and 3rd‑party suppliers where required.
* Working with NEC Client Services Managers (CSMs) to ensure clear communication, professional service delivery, and alignment with expectations.
* Following Problem Management and Change Management processes when investigating issues or completing actions assigned to the consultant.
* Supporting engineering governance and coordination activities linked to incidents, problems, service requests and technical changes.
* Assisting with the management and progression of Problem Records and investigations involving development teams.
* Using available knowledge articles, support documentation and internal guidance to support first\-time fix where possible.
* Supporting data collection, reporting and administrative activities associated with service delivery and engineering operations.
* Creating, reviewing, and updating engineering documentation, operational procedures, work instructions, technical guides and knowledge articles.
* Monitoring and managing incident and service request queues in accordance with ISO20000\-1 processes and ITIL\-aligned practices.
* Capturing accurate information and maintaining detailed case notes in the IT Service Management (ITSM) tool, ensuring actions are recorded and relevant stakeholders are kept informed where required.
* Logging tickets with approved third‑party suppliers and managing ongoing updates through to resolution.
* Completing weekly timesheets and all mandatory NEC training.
* Adhering to NEC corporate policies, standards, and ITIL‑aligned processes.
* Delivering excellent customer service at all times.


**Essential Qualifications \& Experience:**
* General IT support experience, including Microsoft Windows and common Microsoft applications and services.
* Experience in technical support or service delivery roles.
* Understanding of ITIL‑aligned Incident Management.
* Experience managing support tickets within a service management environment.
* Experience working with customers or internal stakeholders to gather information and progress issues.

title: Manager - L&D Content Development
description:
**Role Details:**




**Designation** 
 : Manager
 



**Function:** 
 Human Resources \| Department: L\&D
 



**Reports to:** 
 Director Talent Engagement and Development
 



**Location:** 
 Mumbai (Lower Parel)
 



**Span:** 
 Central L\&D
 



**Experience:** 
 8 – 10 years
 



  





**Role Overview:**




 The Manager \- Content Development designs and builds the learning content used across BDO India. The role turns learning needs into structured, usable content for leadership, behavioural and AI programmes, spanning e\-learning, workshop material, learning resources and assessments. It owns the content design standard every Service Line Academy follows and helps academy experts turn what they know into well designed learning.
 



  





**Key accountabilities:**




**Instructional design:** 



* Turn a learning need into clear objectives, a design and a storyboard, using an established approach such as ADDIE or SAM, and Bloom's Taxonomy to pitch each objective at the right level.
* Design blended learning journeys for the leadership tracks alongside the Leadership and Behavioural Trainers.
* Work with subject matter experts, business leads and HR to draw out raw knowledge and break it into simple, bite sized learning components.



**Content production:** 



* Build e\-learning content: interactive modules, microlearning, video and job aids for self\-paced learning.
* Build workshop content: instructor led decks, facilitator guides, playbooks, participant workbooks and activity material for classroom and virtual sessions.
* Build supporting learning resources: flyers, learning snippets, ready reckoners and post programme reinforcer material that keep learning alive after the session.
* Package content for the learning platform in SCORM and test it before release.



**Assessments and feedback:** 



* Design polls, surveys, pulse checks and feedback forms that capture learner response and inform the next round of content.
* Write knowledge checks, scenario\-based simulations and practical assessments that measure whether learning has actually landed and maintain the question banks.



**Design standard and academy support:** 



* Own the organisation's content design standard and templates and review academy content against them on request.
* Coach academy subject matter experts on how to structure and design what they teach.
* Build the materials for the Internal Facilitation Certificate alongside the trainers.



**Content governance:** 



* Keep the central content library organised, with version control and a refresh date on every item.
* Make sure content built by vendors is owned by BDO India, and that content is accessible to every learner.



  





**Experience and qualifications:**



* 8\-10 years in instructional design or learning content development, with at least 3 years running projects end to end.
* Corporate or professional services experience preferred.
* Hands on skill with authoring tools such as Articulate 360 (Storyline and Rise) or Adobe Captivate, video tools such as Camtasia or Vyond, and design tools such as Canva or the Adobe suite.
* Practical experience using AI Productivity Tools and Multimedia for text, video and voice is preferable.
* Working knowledge of SCORM and how content behaves on a learning platform.
* Graduate or postgraduate degree. An instructional design certification is an advantage.



  





**About BDO:**




 BDO is a global network of professional services firms with a presence in over 166 countries, revenue of over USD 14 billion, and experience of over 60 years. It’s a leading service provider for the mid\-markets with client service at its heart. BDO India Services Private Limited (or ‘BDO India’) is the India member firm of BDO International.
 



 BDO India offers strategic, operational, accounting and tax, and regulatory advisory \& assistance for both domestic and international organizations across a range of industries. BDO India is led by more than 300\+ Partners \& Directors with a team of over 10,000 professionals operating across 14 cities and 20 offices. We expect to grow sizably in the coming 3\-5 years, adding various dimensions to our business and multiplying and increasing the current team size multi\-fold.

title: Data Migration Intern – Google Workspace
description:
**Location:** 
 Mumbai
   

  

**Experience:** 
 0–1 year / Freshers
   

  

**Employment Type:** 
 Internship
   

  

**Duration:** 
 2–3 months
   

  

**Stipend:** 
 Paid
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are looking for a detail\-oriented
 **Data Migration Intern** 
 to support a company\-wide migration of employee email accounts and associated data from one Google Workspace environment to another.
   

  

 The intern will work closely with the People and IT teams to ensure employee data is migrated accurately, systematically and with minimal disruption to business operations.
   

  

 This is a project\-based role and will involve working with employee data, Google Workspace, spreadsheets and migration trackers.
   

  

 What You Will Do
   

  

**Email \& Data Migration**
* Support migration of employee email accounts from the existing Google Workspace/domain to the new Google Workspace/domain.
* Assist with migration of relevant mailbox data, emails, contacts, calendars and other approved Google Workspace data.
* Follow defined migration processes and checklists for each employee/account.
* Ensure data is transferred accurately and completely as per the migration plan.
* Support account setup and configuration activities as required.


**Data Validation \& Quality Checks**
* Maintain a detailed migration tracker covering all employee accounts.
* Verify migrated emails and other data against the source account.
* Identify missing, incomplete or incorrectly migrated data and coordinate resolution.
* Conduct post\-migration checks to ensure employees can access their new accounts and required data.
* Maintain clear records of completed, pending and exception cases.


**Coordination**
* Coordinate with employees to schedule migration activities and resolve basic access\-related queries.
* Work closely with the IT/Google Workspace administrator during the migration.
* Escalate technical issues or exceptions that require administrator intervention.
* Support employee communication around migration timelines, access and required actions.


**Documentation**
* Maintain migration SOPs, checklists and trackers.
* Document recurring issues and their resolutions.
* Prepare daily/weekly migration status reports.
* Maintain appropriate confidentiality while handling employee and business data.


 What We Are Looking For
   

  

* Graduate/student pursuing a degree in Computer Applications, IT, Computer Science, Information Systems, Business or a related field.
* Comfortable working with Google Workspace, particularly Gmail, Google Drive, Google Sheets and Google Calendar.
* Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills.
* High attention to detail and accuracy.
* Good organisational and follow\-up skills.
* Comfortable working with large volumes of data.
* Good written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to follow structured processes and checklists.
* Strong sense of confidentiality and responsibility when handling employee data.


 Good to Have
   

  

* Basic understanding of Google Workspace administration.
* Exposure to email or data migration projects.
* Familiarity with CSV files, data validation and spreadsheet\-based reconciliation.
* Basic troubleshooting skills.
* Experience working with Google Admin Console would be an advantage.


 Key Success Measures
   

  

**The Intern Will Be Expected To Contribute Towards**
* Accurate and timely migration of assigned employee accounts.
* Minimal data loss or migration errors.
* Complete and accurate migration tracking.
* Timely identification and escalation of exceptions.
* Successful post\-migration validation.
* Clear documentation of the migration process.


 What You Will Learn
   

  

* Hands\-on exposure to a real\-world Google Workspace migration.
* Understanding of email, cloud data and user account migration.
* Data validation, reconciliation and project tracking.
* Cross\-functional coordination with People and IT teams.
* Exposure to managing a company\-wide technology transition.


 Important
   

  

 This role will involve access to employee and business information.
 **Confidentiality, data security and adherence to approved migration processes will be mandatory.**

title: Senior Solutions Analyst
description:
**About Quantanite \& QiQ** 




 Quantanite is a BPO company that combines human agents with proprietary AI technology. QiQ (Quantanite iQ) is our flagship AI\-powered contact centre analytics platform built on cutting\-edge agentic AI, knowledge graphs, and large language models.
 



 QiQ functions as a virtual organization of specialized AI agents that analyze customer interactions, generate operational insights, and drive measurable business outcomes. The platform processes voice, email, and chat interactions through intelligent clusters (Operations, Quality, Voice of Customer) to surface KPI insights, root cause analysis, and actionable recommendations.
 



 We're looking for someone who has built agentic systems and can help design, architect, and deliver solutions for clients using this technology.
 



  





**The Role** 




 As a Senior Solutions Analyst, you'll work closely with the Solutions Architect to translate client needs into technical solutions built on agentic AI and knowledge graph architecture. You'll own the full discovery\-to\-delivery cycle for client implementations and feature development, and over time, you'll represent Solutions independently in client conversations and make real architectural decisions.
 



 This role sits at the intersection of business strategy and technical execution. You'll design solutions that leverage agentic patterns, multi\-agent orchestration, RAG pipelines, and knowledge graphs to solve real contact centre problems. You'll also learn Quantanite's specific platform, clients, and domain so that you can eventually operate as a full Solutions Architect.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 ● Client discovery and solutioning: Lead or co\-lead discovery calls with clients to understand their true operational problems, not just their stated requests. Propose solutions architected around agentic AI and knowledge graph patterns.
 



 ● BRD and HLD authorship: Own the creation of Business Requirements Documents (BRDs) and High\-Level Design (HLD) documents that translate client needs into clear, actionable specifications for engineering. Contribute real architectural thinking, not just transcription.
 



 ● Architecture and design decisions: Make calls on solution shape: which problems need agentic systems vs. simpler approaches, how to layer knowledge graphs, when to build custom orchestration vs. use existing patterns. Own the trade\-offs (cost, speed, accuracy, complexity).
 



 ● Cross\-functional coordination: Work with engineering (QLabs), product, and PMO to move projects through the BRD → HLD → TDD → Implementation → As\-built chain. Be the connective tissue between business and engineering.
 



 ● Client representation: Sit in client meetings, present solutions, answer technical questions in real time, and build confidence that Quantanite can deliver. Represent Solutions credibly as a technical leader.
 



 ● QiQ platform ownership: Develop deep working knowledge of QiQ's architecture (agentic clusters, knowledge graph layers, KPI logic, process adherence frameworks) so you can design solutions that leverage it effectively and make informed decisions about extensions.
 



 ● Learning and growth: Master Quantanite's specific clients, domain (contact centres, BPO operations), and go\-to\-market positioning.
 



  





**Required Qualifications** 




**Technical Expertise** 




**Generative AI and agentic systems** 




 ● Hands\-on experience building agentic systems
 



 ● Deep understanding of multi\-agent orchestration, agent frameworks like LangChain and LangGraph
 



 ● Proven work with RAG pipelines, prompt engineering, and LLM context window management
 



 ● Experience with knowledge graphs or similar structured knowledge systems
 



 ● Can speak credibly about what's possible and what's not with current LLM technology
 



 ● Understands cost, latency, and token efficiency trade\-offs in system design
 



  





**Systems and architectural thinking** 




 ● Can decompose complex business problems into architectural solutions
 



 ● Understands when to build agentic systems vs. simpler rule\-based or API\-driven approaches
 



 ● Experience designing systems that scale (volume, complexity, cost)
 



 ● Can reason through trade\-offs and make justified design decisions
 



  





**Business and Communication** 




**Business acumen and problem translation** 




 ● Can understand client/stakeholder problems at a deep level and propose solutions that actually address root causes
 



 ● Can articulate technical solutions in business terms (impact, cost, risk, timeline)
 



 ● Comfortable with client\-facing conversations and requirements gathering
 



  





**Communication and presence** 




 ● Strong written communication: can author clear, precise technical specifications
 



 ● Strong verbal communication: can present to clients and executives without losing credibility
 



 ● Can think on your feet and handle real\-time questions in a meeting
 



 ● Naturally commands respect in rooms with non\-technical stakeholders
 



  





**Ownership and accountability** 




 ● Track record of seeing projects through from start to finish
 



 ● Takes responsibility for outcomes, not just activities
 



 ● Drives outcomes even when unclear or complex

title: Associate Consultant/Consultant (Strategy)
description:
**Blue Matter Consulting** 
 is a strategy consulting firm focused exclusively on the life sciences industry. We partner with biotech startups and multinational pharmaceutical corporations to help them achieve commercial success across the lifecycle of their products, portfolios, and organizations. Our work spans new product planning, launch strategy, brand and lifecycle planning, and corporate and portfolio strategy across specialty therapeutic areas. We operate globally, with offices in the US (San Francisco, New York, Boston), Europe (London, Zurich, Netherlands), and India (Mumbai, Gurgaon, Pune).
 



  





**The Role** 




 As an Associate Consultant or Consultant in our India office, you will work as an integrated member of US\- and Europe\-based project teams — directly engaging global clients, contributing to live strategy engagements, and building deliverables that shape commercial and corporate decisions.
 



 This is not a support or back\-office role. You will own meaningful workstreams, present to clients, and operate with the same expectations as your US/Europe counterparts. The role involves working partial overlap hours with US or European time zones a few days each week; work timing flexibility is provided.
 



  





**Primary Resonsibilities** 



* Onboard rapidly to new engagements — internalize objectives, scope, and timelines, and integrate with the US/Europe project team from day one
* Conduct primary and secondary research in a time\-bound manner
* Identify key insights, recommendations, opportunities, and threats to inform corporate and commercial strategies
* Create and utilize analytical tools to support strategic decision\-making
* Develop slides or memos effectively communicating results of analyses
* Prepare material for project meetings, workshops, and client presentations
* Proactively communicate progress, flag risks, and seek guidance from senior team members
* Demonstrate accountability for completion and high\-quality delivery of all assigned responsibilities
* Engage with global clients regularly (e.g., weekly updates, workshops, interim and final presentations)
* Participate in and contribute to internal initiatives including business development, knowledge management, and new capabilities development



  





**Who We Are Looking For** 




 We look for consultants who can hit the ground running in a project team, are scientifically trained (by experience or academic background), and demonstrate strength across four core competencies:
 


* **Critical Thinker** 
 — Able to approach a problem, understand its context and implications, and work with ambiguous information to develop creative and pragmatic solutions
* **Collaborative** 
 — Able to plan your own work, deliver on commitments to your project team, and operate effectively across time zones and cultures
* **Communicative** 
 — Able to interact transparently and concisely with internal and external stakeholders, both verbally and in writing
* **Proactive** 
 — Able to take initiative, eager to learn, receptive to feedback, and willing to take failure in stride



  





**Desired Experience and Skills** 



* Understanding of clinical trial phases and their impact on strategic decision\-making
* Demonstrated ability to integrate scientific, business, and industry knowledge in developing creative solutions for clients
* Strong analytical skills and structured, hypothesis\-driven problem\-solving
* Excellent written and oral communication skills
* Ability to manage competing priorities under tight timelines
* Demonstrated ability to work in a team environment
* Proactive and entrepreneurial in spirit
* Willingness and ability to read complex scientific material and distill key insights
* Proficiency in MS PowerPoint and Excel
* Experience using proprietary pharma databases
* Experience with pharma marketing analytics, valuation, or forecasting/modeling is a plus
* Prior demonstrated success working across time zones with international teams is a plus



  





**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Advanced degree(s) in the biology domain — PhD, MBBS, MD, BDS, MS, BPharm/MPharm, PharmD, or MPH
* 2–3 years of prior consulting experience, OR at least 2–3 years of biopharma industry experience in roles such as portfolio planning, corporate strategy, or business development
* US/Europe life sciences industry knowledge and exposure is a plus



  





**What We Can Offer You** 



* Diverse, intellectually stimulating projects across our clients' products, portfolios, and organizations — from biotech startups to multinational pharmaceutical corporations
* Direct engagement with global clients and US/Europe project teams from day one
* Supportive environment to learn and grow, regardless of your starting skill and knowledge level
* Being empowered to drive your development, own your work, and manage your time
* Hybrid office and home working model (depending on project schedules)
* Structured onboarding program to help you build core consulting skills
* Support for your developmental journey with:
* A
 **peer\-level buddy** 
 to help you navigate your way around Blue Matter and share their experiences
* A
 **senior\-level career coach** 
 to support your overall professional development and career progression
* A
 
**senior\-level India\-based local mentor** 

 for ad hoc guidance and support

title: Proposal Engineer
description:
**Company Description** 
 Intrelec is a long\-established provider of engineered Switchgear Panels, including MCCs, intelligent MCCs, PCCs, distribution boards, VFD and soft starter panels, as well as LV and HV busducts. For more than 47 years, the company has focused on complex, large\-scale industrial projects in sectors such as oil and gas, petrochemicals, specialty chemicals, fertilizers, mining, and cement. Most projects are delivered in partnership with leading engineering consultants, and Intrelec is approved by many prominent industry players. A key strength is its indigenously designed, type\-tested, and cost\-effective drawout assemblies, supplied for over four decades to process industries. These solutions have enabled Intrelec to be considered on par with global manufacturers and to export drawout assemblies to clients in Africa, the Middle East, and Southeast Asia.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Proposal Engineer role at Intrelec is a full\-time, on\-site position based in Mumbai. The individual will be responsible for preparing and writing technical and commercial proposals for switchgear panels and related electrical solutions, ensuring alignment with client specifications and industry standards. Day\-to\-day tasks include reviewing tender documents, coordinating with engineering, procurement, and sales teams to gather inputs, and developing accurate cost estimates and bid documentation. The Proposal Engineer will interact with clients and consultants to clarify technical queries, support negotiations, and update proposal content based on feedback. The role also involves maintaining proposal templates, tracking bid status, and contributing to continuous improvement of proposal processes and tools.
   

**Qualifications**
* Strong skills in proposal preparation and proposal writing, including interpretation of technical specifications and tender documents.
* Solid foundation in electrical engineering, preferably with experience in switchgear panels, MCCs, PCCs, or related power distribution systems.
* Experience collaborating with sales teams, supporting pre\-sales activities, and contributing to technical presentations or client meetings.
* Exposure to procurement processes, including sourcing technical information and cost data from suppliers and internal stakeholders.
* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or a related discipline; relevant industrial or project experience is an advantage.
* Ability to analyze technical drawings, single\-line diagrams, and equipment lists with attention to detail and accuracy.
* Effective written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present complex technical information clearly.
* Proficiency in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint); familiarity with ERP or bidding tools is beneficial.
* Strong organizational and time\-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple proposals and deadlines.
* Commitment to ethical, inclusive, and collaborative working practices in a diverse team environment.

description:

That means we’re continually investing heavily into R\&D for new services and solutions while proactively assessing what the industry needs today and tomorrow.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Be the primary liaison for assigned Key Accounts on technical and operational matters which cannot be solved neither by DATE, nor by the Operational Centres or the surveyor network. Help the assigned Key Accounts maintain smooth technical operations and continuous vessel trade by providing personal attention, outstanding competence and added value in identifying, solving and advising the customer on those technical and operational issues in alignment with DNV’s purpose, business objectives and principles.
   

  

 The result is that you maintain and develop a trustful win\-win relationship and contribute to high customer satisfaction and loyalty which build an important foundation for DNV to maintain a high quality fleet, successfully retain existing business and secure new business.
   

  

 Team up with the relevant Key Account Manager (KAM) and work collaboratively with the Account Team and all relevant departments within DNV to ensure that excellent technical customer service levels are delivered.
   

  

 Be an important part of the Key Account Planning and Implementation process to help the KAM prepare and execute a high\-impact Key Account Plan, Account Strategy and Actions that adds value to the customer and to DNV. Provide input to the KAM on the Key Account\`s technical needs and expectations, relevant technology and regulatory developments, suitable strategies and actions related to the Key Account\`s technical issues and technical operations. Help implement the assigned actions according to plan.
   

  

 Develop and strengthen the customer relationship, operating at the Key Account\`s technical department and technical management levels, to achieve preferred supplier status based on lasting personal relationships and the added value delivered.
   

  

 Solve and advise on operational requests, customer technical concerns and technical complaints related to survey and audit performance in close collaboration with relevant technical experts and the KAM to ensure continuous vessel trade. Hand over customer requests to DATE or Operations Centres in case the requests fall into the service scope of those units.
   

  

 Systematically identify any major technical and technical operation challenges and technical concerns related to the DNV interaction with the Key Account and cascade to the KAM and to relevant departments within DNV. Follow\-up with the findings and ensure that related improvement activities are executed under utilization of the relevant DNV organization.
   

  

 Bring in foresight and help spot and resolve potential technical problems before they occur.
   

  

 Consult the customer on technical matters in meetings, presentations and workshops together or in alignment with the KAM and relevant stakeholders within DNV .

 Measure and monitor the Key Account\`s performance on critical technical key performance indicators, address and support improving performance gaps by developing adequate plans and actions in alignment with the KAM and the relevant DNV organization as well as the Key Account.
   

  

 While your focus is on technical issues, remain attentive towards identifying potential business opportunities and hand those over to the KAM.
   

  

 Pro\-actively stay up to date with relevant industry, regulatory and technology trends and best practices as well as with the relevant DNV products, services, processes and tools to remain relevant towards the Key Accounts.
   

  

 Liaise with Indian flag for Flag related matters.
   

  

 Experience working with MOU’s is an added advantage.
   

  

 What we offer

* Generous Paid Leaves (Annual, Sick, Compassionate, Local Public, Marriage, Maternity, Paternity, Medical leave)

 DNV is an Equal Opportunity Employer and gives consideration for employment to qualified applicants without regard to gender, religion, race, national or ethnic origin, cultural background, social group, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, age or political opinion. Diversity is fundamental to our culture and we invite you to be part of this diversity.
   

  

**About You**
* Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in the maritime/offshore industry, with exposure to ship and MOU operations, classification requirements, and customer\-facing roles.

**Summary**
 We are seeking a
 **Business Program \& Operations Analyst – UAT \& Implementation** 
 to support a highly visible, enterprise\-wide refrigeration temperature monitoring and automation initiative being deployed across approximately 7,530 retail locations. This large\-scale program is transforming a traditionally manual temperature\-checking and logging process through sensor technology, automated data collection, temperature alerts, and work\-order automation.
   

  

 The program is designed to provide greater visibility into refrigeration equipment performance, identify potential equipment and temperature issues earlier, reduce product loss, support compliance requirements, improve preventive and corrective maintenance processes, and generate significant operational efficiencies and cost savings.
   

  

 In this role, you will help ensure the program is successfully implemented across the store network by supporting business requirements, User Acceptance Testing (UAT), process and SOP validation, training, operational readiness, implementation quality, and go\-live activities. You will work cross\-functionally with project managers, refrigeration engineers, facilities teams, vendors, business stakeholders, and other program resources to ensure solutions meet business requirements and implementations remain on schedule without compromising quality.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will bring approximately 2–3 years of relevant Business Analyst or program implementation experience, with hands\-on exposure to UAT, business process testing, requirements validation, training, and implementation readiness. Experience supporting retail, facilities, store operations, or large\-scale multi\-site implementations would be especially valuable.
   

  

**Click Apply Now To Join The Chamberlain Experience.**
**What You Will Be Accountable For**
* Support the implementation and deployment of a large\-scale refrigeration temperature monitoring and automation program across approximately 7,530 retail locations.
* Partner with business stakeholders to gather, define, document, clarify, and validate business and operational requirements.
* Ensure new processes, system functionality, and implementations align with established business requirements and operational needs.
* Lead and coordinate User Acceptance Testing (UAT), including test execution, business process validation, issue identification, documentation, and follow\-through.
* Validate system functionality, workflows, and business processes prior to deployment.
* Review and validate Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) to ensure processes are accurate, practical, and aligned with business requirements.
* Identify gaps, defects, process issues, or operational risks uncovered during testing and implementation and coordinate with appropriate stakeholders through resolution.

* Support implementation and training activities associated with facilities and work\-order management processes.
* Coordinate with project managers, refrigeration engineers, facilities teams, vendors, store stakeholders, and other program resources throughout the rollout.
* Help ensure installations and implementations are completed correctly and meet established business and quality standards.
* Support data validation activities to ensure information captured during implementation is accurate and complete.
* Track testing activities, implementation issues, dependencies, readiness items, and stakeholder deliverables through completion.
* Balance an aggressive implementation timeline with the need for high\-quality testing, validation, and execution.
* Support successful go\-live activities and the transition of new processes into ongoing business operations.
* Identify opportunities to improve business processes, implementation effectiveness, operational consistency, and user adoption.


**What Qualifications You Need**
* Approximately 2–3 years of relevant Business Analyst experience, including business analysis, program/project implementation, business operations, or a related area.
* Bachelor's degree preferred; equivalent relevant professional experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.
* Hands\-on experience supporting User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and/or business process testing.
* Experience gathering, documenting, clarifying, and validating business requirements.
* Experience supporting implementation projects and validating that solutions meet established business and operational requirements.
* Experience identifying issues during testing or implementation and coordinating with cross\-functional stakeholders through resolution.
* Exposure to SOP/process validation, operational readiness, training, or go\-live activities strongly preferred.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to identify process gaps, risks, and inconsistencies.
* Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple activities, deadlines, and stakeholders within a fast\-paced implementation.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to work effectively across business, technical, vendor, facilities, and operational teams.
* Ability to work independently in a remote environment while remaining highly engaged with a cross\-functional project team.
* Ability to maintain a strong focus on both implementation timelines and quality within a highly visible program.
* Must be available to work primarily during 8:00 AM–5:00 PM CST business hours, with some flexibility to start approximately one hour earlier or later.
* Ability and willingness to travel to Deerfield, IL up to approximately three times during the nine\-month engagement.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience supporting retail, retail facilities, store operations, refrigeration, facilities operations, or other multi\-site environments.
* Experience supporting large\-scale program implementations or enterprise rollouts across multiple locations.
* Experience working with facilities or work\-order management processes and platforms.
* Experience with Azure DevOps (ADO) for project, testing, issue, or implementation tracking.
* Exposure to ServiceChannel or similar facilities/work\-order management systems.
* Experience with data collection tools or platforms used to support implementation and validation activities.

title: Institutional Equity Division - Senior Manager, EMEA Equity Documentation Negotiator (Mumbai)
description:
EMEA Equity Documentation( ISDA) , Institutional Equity Division
   

  

 This role is in Mumbai and requires working with the EMEA Equity Documentation Group based in London. The role will require a fast\-learning, dynamic, pro\-active, and self\-motivated person to assist the team in its day\-to\-day activities.
   

  

 The current opening is for a professional within the EMEA team, based in Mumbai, with responsibility for documentation aspects of OTC derivative transactions, prime brokerage, cash and stock\-lending transactions in the EMEA region.
   

  

**Global Capital Markets:** 
 In the Global Capital Markets division, we offer Global expertise in market analysis and in advisory and capital\-raising services for corporations, institutions, and governments
   

  

 From global institutions to hedge funds, investors come to Morgan Stanley for sales, trading, and market\-making services in almost every type of financial instrument in all the world’s financial markets. Morgan Stanley professionals use our network and technology to provide liquidity and sophisticated analysis, to manage risk and execute reliably in the fast\-changing markets.
   

  

 Morgan Stanley’s Institutional Equity Division (IED) is a world leader in the origination, distribution and trading of equity, equity\-linked and equity\-derivative securities. Our broad and deep client relationships, market\-leading platform and intellectual insights enable us to be a world\-class service provider to our clients for their financing, market access and portfolio management needs.
   

  

 Global Markets Group is the offshoring arm of Morgan Stanley’s Sales \& Trading businesses in India. It covers functions across IED ranging from those associated with sales, trading, analytics, strats to risk management.
   

  

 Since 1935, Morgan Stanley is known as a global leader in financial services, continuously evolving and innovating to better serve our clients and our communities in more than 40 countries around the world.
   

  

**What You’ll Do In The Role**
* Manage the team of lawyers on the ground, co\-ordinate with stakeholder on team dynamics, work management and allocations. Grooming/ training of team
* Draft, negotiate and execute (including amendments to) master derivatives agreements, including but not limited to ISDA, VM CSA, IM CSA, equity swaps /options and prime brokerage related documentation.
* Review and analyze constitutional documents of the client, to establish their capacity and authority capabilities for entering derivative transactions with Morgan Stanley.
* Review and analyze capacity and authority legal opinion from external counsel and highlight issues to Risk and Legal for approvals where applicable.
* Work closely with MS internal stakeholders, to obtain approvals on deviated terms identified in negotiable agreements, with clear implication on deviated terms to enable internal stakeholders to make informed decisions.
* Handle business unit’s queries on the terms of documentation ISD handles.
* Participate in globally or locally led projects related to documentation requirements.
* Undertake tasks directly related to the coordination and lifecycle management of the clients’ agreements and act as the primary point of contact for the clients for all tasks originating from the Asia Pacific region.
* Responsible for administering and facilitating the agreement execution process; maintain and update clients’ contract database/systems; attend to day\-to\-day coordination among internal procurement and legal teams with respect to such contracts; and perform due diligence to ensure contract terms and conditions as well as information of the parties is reflected in the client’s contract database/systems.


**What You’ll Bring To The Role**
* Law graduate with relevant 8\-11 years of experience in financing/derivatives is preferred. Legal qualification is advantageous.
* Experience in team management will be preferred.
* In\-house documentation negotiation experience or paralegal experience in corporate law firm is preferred.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills. Prepared to speak to clients (internal and external) at all times.
* Proficiency in English is a must. Good team player with potential to lead a team.
* Solid quantitative skills and strong interest in business, economics, and law.
* Willingness and ability to provide quality service to the Firm's clients and to promote and enhance the Firm franchise.
* Willingness to work in dynamic environment and the ability to excel under pressure.
* Proficiency and interest in technology and systems development.
* Organized, pro\-active, ability to multi\-task and work efficiently, detail\-oriented, and self\-sufficient.


**What You Can Expect From Morgan Stanley**
 At Morgan Stanley, we raise, manage and allocate capital for our clients – helping them reach their goals. We do it in a way that’s differentiated – and we’ve done that for 90 years. Our values \- putting clients first, doing the right thing, leading with exceptional ideas, committing to diversity and inclusion, and giving back \- aren’t just beliefs, they guide the decisions we make every day to do what's best for our clients, communities and more than 80,000 employees in 1,200 offices across 42 countries. At Morgan Stanley, you’ll find an opportunity to work alongside the best and the brightest, in an environment where you are supported and empowered. Our teams are relentless collaborators and creative thinkers, fueled by their diverse backgrounds and experiences. We are proud to support our employees and their families at every point along their work\-life journey, offering some of the most attractive and comprehensive employee benefits and perks in the industry. There’s also ample opportunity to move about the business for those who show passion and grit in their work.
   

  

 To learn more about our offices across the globe, please copy and paste https://www.morganstanley.com/about\-us/global\-offices into your browser.
   

  

 Morgan Stanley is an equal opportunity employer committed to building and maintaining a workforce that is diverse in experience and background. Our recruiting efforts reflect our strong commitment to a culture of inclusion, where individuals are hired, developed, and advanced based on their skills and talents.
   

  

 Our workforce reflects a broad cross\-section of the global communities in which we operate, bringing a variety of backgrounds, talents, perspectives, and experiences.
   

  

 For more information, please visit: https://www.morganstanley.com/people\-opportunities/eeo.
